definition: Within eight two-object failures, the actor after go-to-destination chose look while map contained move item to that destination; previously took that item and had made an earlier move to the same destination. Record every matching d and select earliest for each case.
limits: This counts one precise posthoc surface signature, not every possible placement opportunity, hidden semantic condition, or policy for unseen tasks. Repeated d in a case are not independent; no claim of reachability, completion or teacher success.
